title: TerraJuke original vinyl artwork (created 2026-11-06, when the project was named Earth FM)
model: The tool did not report or expose selection of a model version. Image 2.6 Sunburst was requested by BoboMimi; that exact model identity is unverified.
method: Original generated artwork, uniformly reduced to 512 pixels and encoded as JPEG for web delivery. No NASA asset was supplied as an input.
meaning: Artistic abstract record surface. It is not Earth observation imagery, a scientific map, a sonification input, or a depiction of an actual instrument recording.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: a production texture for the playable vinyl record in the Earth FM web jukebox, also used by a small Three.js record. Generate ONE square, completely front-facing orthographic flat-lay image of an exquisitely crafted black vinyl record, centred and perfectly circular, occupying 98% of the square, on a matching near-black navy background. No perspective tilt, no cast shadow outside the disc, no turntable, no sleeve, no UI. Fine concentric pressed grooves, satin black polymer with subtle cool teal and champagne glints, premium observatory instrument aesthetic. The circular centre label is about 32% of the disc diameter: an original abstract 'Earth as sound' artwork of flowing opalescent teal, pale chartreuse and muted champagne currents forming an elegant orbital globe / sunburst. The centre artwork must be an artistic abstraction with no identifiable continents, no scientific graph, no numerical encoding and no NASA imagery. Keep the groove area dark and restrained; the centre has a luminous, tactile, collectible record identity. A tiny black spindle hole at the exact centre. No words, letters, digits, logos, watermarks or typographic marks anywhere; the app overlays real Side A/B labels. Sharp, refined physical surface detail, coherent radial geometry, beautifully controlled lighting. The whole record must remain fully visible and suitable as a circular texture, with no foreground obstruction. Colour palette is near-black navy #08121c, dark petrol teal, soft chartreuse #d5f38b, pearl and very restrained warm copper. This is original Earth FM record art, not a scientific Earth observation.
